operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Changes the status of a booking. Pass the booking id and the target status code in the path.

| Value | Status |
|---|---|
| 0 | Pending |
| 1 | Confirmed |
| 2 | Invoiced (set automatically when the booking is converted to an invoice) |
| 3 | Cancelled |
| 4 | Done |

Typically you set `1` (Confirmed), `3` (Cancelled), or `4` (Done). The request always responds with HTTP 200 carrying an `error` flag: `error` is `false` when the status was changed, and `true` when it was not (for example an unsupported status, or a booking already converted to an invoice). A booking id that does not exist returns 404.

The `.json` extension is optional.

200.description: Always returned (HTTP 200) whether or not the change applied — check the `error` flag. Success: `{"message":"Status Changed Successfully","error":false}`. Not applied: `{"message":"","error":true}`.

message.description: Result message. Empty when the change was not applied.

error.description: `false` when the status was changed; `true` when it was not applied (unsupported status, or booking already converted).

404.description: No booking exists with the given id.
